newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: Paraguay to sell 80 pct of phone company - sources.
newsitem.headline: Paraguay to sell 80 pct of phone company - sources.

text.p: The Paraguayan government will present to Congress in October a plan to privatize 80 percent of state telecommunications company Antelco, government sources told Reuters Tuesday.
Some 70 percent of the stock will be sold to private investors, 20 percent will remain in state hands and 10 percent will be distributed among company employees.
Antelco's value is estimated at between $500 and $800 million but the government source did not rule out that the state could raise more than that if interest were high from international bidders.
The Economy Ministry started studying the sale of Antelco on Monday.
